text:
sudha: Quick personal update — adopted a rescue ferret yesterday! 🎉🥹 Meet Neo. I brought him home and he already stole my favorite slipper. Pics coming.
joel: NO WAY. Congrats Sudha!! Ferret tax pls. 😍
amanda: OMG ferret!!! when's the official meet-and-greet at HQ? i need to coo in person. 🥰
sudha: thinking low-key next Friday after 3pm. he’s crate-trained and super chill. i’ll bring treats & a tiny harness. (yes i bought the harness)
people-ops-bot: @sudha reminder: office pets require pre-clearance and an updated pet registry entry. Please submit the short form so facilities can confirm allergies/space. link: https://intranet/people-ops/pets
sudha: already submitted it this morning! thanks for the heads up.
alex: cute overload. congrats!! any name backstory?
sudha: named him Neo because he loves napping in weird places and has a ‘chosen one’ energy. also he photobombs my zooms.
joel: chosen one energy is accurate. can we get a villain origin story? :evil_smile:
amanda: rescue ferret > everything. huge kudos to you for adopting.
sudha: shelter was called Ferrets of the East. ~6 months old, neutered, vaccinated, microchipped. adoption fee covered, paperwork in my drive if anyone’s curious.
joel: also — tiny sweater?
sudha: yes. tiny sweater confirmed. photos: [IMG_2026_neo1.jpg] [IMG_2026_neo2.jpg]
alex: dropping a heart reaction. :heart:
amanda: :raised_hands: love him. see you Friday, Sudha!
sudha: thanks y’all — appreciate the warm welcome. will bring ferret-safe snacks and maybe a tiny leash demo. (not bringing the slipper lol)
